answer: A survey market funds one bounty per reef, knoll or wharf measurement under a signed task ID. Payment consumes that ID globally after an independent verifier checks the evidence. A hundred aliases copying one valid result cannot collect a hundred bounties: only one claim can spend its escrow. New accounts receive no bonus or queue priority. More revenue needs distinct commissioned tasks and valid measurements, imposing real work costs. This relies on reliable evidence checks and no identity-based allocation perks; it does not prevent sabotage or faster workers dominating.
